That is a first-party bulk action, but it runs through an AI assistant rather than direct multi-select. Filters only auto-apply labels to incoming mail, which is adjacent automation and not credited. missing for 10: documented multi-select of conversations in the inbox UI, bulk archive, bulk mark-done/read, select-all across search results, independent or hands-on corroboration.
